title: 第3章 杀刘章第4章 虎煞刀法
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
因为追风盗没有固定的据点，都是劫掠到哪里，就在哪里定居一段时间，之后再换个地方继续劫掠。
再加上追风盗只对村庄或者弱小一些的商队下手，所以才一直活跃到现在还没被剿灭。
而追风盗的老大就是齐源之前见到的村长，刘磊！练肉境界！
凭借练肉境界跟一手虎煞刀法，除非上百人围攻，想办法耗尽他的气力，不然留不下他！
还有一个老二刘章，练皮境界，据说已经快要进阶练肉了！
根据二虎所知道的，这个世界武者境界分为练皮、练肉、练骨、练脏、练髓、换血
给齐源的第一印象就是人体能练的都拿去练了。
至于更强的武者肯定也有，因为每个大城的城主都是换血境界的高手担任。
而能够掌控他们的大周朝廷肯定有更厉害的武者，不过这就不是二虎能知道的了。
“我知道的都说了，放过我吧，你不是在山里迷路了吗？我知道去城里的路，我可以给你带路的！”二虎脸色苍白的说道。
齐源看着二虎被洞穿的四肢，再看看二虎因为失血过多已经面色苍白的脸：“糊涂！你四肢都被洞穿了，而且还流了这么多血，怎么给我带路，你以为我像你们那样狠毒吗！”
听到齐源说的，二虎张了张嘴刚想要说些什么，但是被齐源打断。
齐源说道：“放心，虽然我没杀过人，但是我直接一剑枭首，应该不会痛的。”
听到这话的二虎直接双眼睁大，想要大声呼救，但下一刻，饮血剑化作剑光，直接把二虎枭首，看着二虎掉在地上的首级，齐源面无表情。
虽然以前经常想象到在异世界大杀四方，但那毕竟是想象，齐源动手的前一刻都以为自己会像小说里的一些主角，第一次杀人一样不适、呕吐、反胃。
但齐源没有，直到二虎首级掉在地上，也是面无表情，好像就应该是这样的！
看着二虎的尸身一会，齐源也只是说出一句：“生命太脆弱了！”
然后直接发动饮血剑的特性，吸取二虎尸身的全部气血！
之前为了问出消息，齐源一直没有让饮血剑自由发挥自己的特性，现在知道消息了，那就不用顾忌那么多了！
只见鲜血从二虎伤口处飘出，飞向饮血剑，等接近饮血剑之后化作一股红色雾气，被漂浮在空中的饮血剑吸收。

二虎身体慢慢变得干瘪，等到吸收完，二虎身体已经变成一具干尸！
抓住饮血剑剑柄，被饮血剑吸收的红色雾气顺着剑柄开始进入到齐源身体内。
齐源感觉一股暖流在体内四处游走，所过之处五脏六腑，筋骨皮膜等等都在变强。
跟这个世界需要练皮，练肉一步步来不一样，饮血剑是直接从内到外全身的增强，直到身体的极限。
“呼，这种变强的感觉还真是令人着迷。”齐源双手握拳感受着变强的身体感慨道。
从饱受加班摧残导致大大小小一堆毛病的身躯，到如今强壮的身躯，只要简简单单一个人的气血。
这让齐源有了新的想法，山路难行，现在就走，而且对路还不熟悉，要是后面被他们追上，那就被动了，还不如主动出击，
而且齐源打算把这些追风盗化作变强的养料！
content_en:
Because the chasing bandits don't have a fixed base, they always plunder wherever they go, settle there for a period of time, and then move to another place to continue plundering.
In addition, the Wind Chasing Bandits only attack villages or smaller caravans, so they have remained active until now and have not been wiped out.
And the boss of Chai Feng Pirates is the village chief whom Qi Yuan met before, Liu Lei! The realm of meat training!
With the realm of meat training and the skill of the tiger sword, unless hundreds of people surround him and find a way to exhaust his energy, he will not be able to stay!
There is also the second child, Liu Zhang, who is in the realm of skin training. It is said that he is about to advance to meat training!
According to what Erhu knows, the realm of warriors in this world is divided into skin training, meat training, bone training, internal organs training, marrow training, and blood exchange.
The first impression he had on Qi Yuan was that he had practiced everything the human body could do.
As for stronger warriors, there must be some, because the city lord of each big city is a master of the blood exchange realm.
And there must be more powerful warriors in the Zhou Dynasty who can control them, but this is not what Erhu can know.
"I've told you everything I know. Let me go. Aren't you lost in the mountains? I know the way to the city. I can lead you!" Erhu said with a pale face.
Qi Yuan looked at Erhu's pierced limbs, and then at Erhu's pale face due to excessive blood loss: "Confused! Your limbs are pierced, and you're bleeding so much. How can you lead the way for me? Do you think I'm as vicious as you guys!"
After hearing what Qi Yuan said, Erhu opened his mouth and was about to say something, but was interrupted by Qi Yuan.
Qi Yuan said: "Don't worry, although I have never killed anyone, it shouldn't hurt if I just kill him with a sword."
After hearing this, Erhu's eyes widened and he wanted to shout for help, but the next moment, the blood-drinking sword turned into sword light and directly decapitated Erhu. Looking at Erhu's head that fell to the ground, Qi Yuan had no expression on his face.
Although he had often imagined killing people in a different world, it was just imagination after all. The moment before Qi Yuan took action, he thought he would be as uncomfortable, vomiting, and nauseated as some of the protagonists in the novel who killed people for the first time.
But Qi Yuan didn't, until Erhu's head fell to the ground, his face was expressionless, as if it should be like this!
After looking at Erhu's body for a while, Qi Yuan just said: "Life is too fragile!"
Then directly activate the characteristics of the blood-drinking sword to absorb all the energy and blood from Erhu's corpse!
In order to find out the news, Qi Yuan had not allowed the Blood-Drinking Sword to freely display its characteristics. Now that he knows the news, he doesn't have to worry so much!
I saw blood floating out from Erhu's wound and flying towards the blood-drinking sword. When it got close to the blood-drinking sword, it turned into a red mist and was absorbed by the blood-drinking sword floating in the air.
Erhu's body slowly became shriveled up, and by the time the absorption was complete, Erhu's body had turned into a mummy!
Grasping the hilt of the blood-drinking sword, the red mist absorbed by the blood-drinking sword began to enter Qi Yuan's body along the hilt.
Qi Yuan felt a warm current moving around in his body, and wherever it passed, the internal organs, muscles, bones, skin, and membranes were all getting stronger.
Unlike this world where you need to train your skin and train your body step by step, the Blood Drinking Sword directly strengthens your whole body from the inside out until your body reaches its limit.
"Huh, this feeling of getting stronger is really fascinating." Qi Yuan clenched his hands into fists and sighed, feeling his stronger body.
From a body that suffered from overtime and a lot of ailments, to a strong body now, it only needs a single person's energy and blood.
This gave Qi Yuan a new idea. The mountain road is difficult to travel. He should leave now, and he is not familiar with the road. If they catch up later, he will be passive. It is better to take the initiative.
And Qi Yuan plans to turn these wind-chasing thieves into nourishment for becoming stronger!
